subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

The killing of a whole race
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3' **i.e. **'Genocide'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** option that can be used** as a one-word substitute for the given group of words is** 3) Genocide.**
 
• **Genocide refers **to the deliberate and systematic extermination or killing of a large number of people from a particular racial, ethnic, or national group.(नरसंहार)
 
• **It involves** the destruction of an entire race or ethnic group.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Genocide'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Patricide:** The act of killing one's own father.(पितृहत्या)
 
• **Matricide:** The act of killing one's own mother.(मातृहत्या)
 
• **Infanticide:** The act of killing an infant or a young child.(शिशुहत्या)
